_note: v2.5 plan 09 SP1 S3, LIVE on the dev build, spike flag ON. so-scenario run --sandbox --group <id>. One real turn (swipe 0, recorded after its reads settle), one generated swipe (/swipe direction=right, swipe 1, recorded the same way), then 10 swipe-backs alternating left/right between the two already-read swipes (ST emits only MESSAGE_SWIPED for an existing swipe, script.js:10315/10319). Each swipe-back must be a cache hit, start 0 read calls (audits created between the swipe and scheduler idle, quiet 8 s), and leave engine + queued writes + live memory rows equal to that swipe's recording (S1's projection).

steps.eval: const ctx = SillyTavern.getContext(); const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; if (!ctx.groupId || !ctx.chatId) throw new Error('needs a group chat (so-scenario --sandbox --group <id>)'); if (!globalThis.storyOrchestratorSpikes?.swipeBackCache) throw new Error('the SP1 spike module is not loaded: serve the dev build (npm run build:dev && npm run serve:dev)'); for (const key of Object.keys(globalThis).filter((k) => k.startsWith('storyOrchestratorDebug'))) delete globalThis[key]; const settings = ctx.extensionSettings['story-orchestrator']?.settings; if (!settings) throw new Error('no settings root'); const before = settings.spikes ? { ...settings.spikes } : null; settings.spikes = { ...(settings.spikes ?? {}), swipeBackCache: true }; ctx.saveSettingsDebounced(); if (rt.getGlobalSettings().spikes?.swipeBackCache !== true) throw new Error('the spike flag did not land'); const live = (row) => !row.supersededBy && (!row.provenance || row.provenance.validity === 'live'); globalThis.__sp1 = { before, flag: true, records: {}, legs: [] }; globalThis.__sp1.snap = () => { const s = rt.getEngineState(); const engine = rt.engine; return { engine: { active: s.activeCheckpointId, boundary: s.boundary, values: s.blackboard.values, versions: s.blackboard.versions, path: s.visitedPath, last: s.lastMessageId, started: s.checkpointStartedMessageId }, pending: (engine?.pendingWrites ?? []).map((w) => ({ range: w.turnRange ?? null, deltas: (w.deltas ?? []).map((d) => d.q + '=' + JSON.stringify(d.v)) })), memory: [...new Set((rt.getSnapshot().memory?.entries ?? []).filter(live).map((r) => r.tier + '|' + (r.messageId ?? '-') + '|' + r.text))].sort() }; }; const read = rt.getGlobalSettings(); return { flag: true, before, cadence: read.extraction.cadence, judge: read.judge.enabled };

send_generate.text: I set my pack down by the long table and ask Ponticius what work the guild has.
